## Bounded-scope decisions (recorded honestly)

- **Agency rows only, complement as a count.** `operator_screen` captures
  the reviewed agency-operated rows (OBJECTID + geometry) and collapses
  every other published row to ONE `programme_count` — the
  private-operator value list is never declared, fetched or captured; a
  screen miss lands in the count, never a fabricated device.
- **Registrant-class layers are count-only.** Project Green Light, the
  unresolved-CCSO layer and the three drone flight logs serve ONE
  `returnCountOnly` page — the published total is the claim; row bytes
  never cross.
- **Unresolved agency → whole-layer count.** The west-Georgia CCSO
  layer's owning org is unresolved in the candidate record, so it runs
  `count_only` — no evidenced operator value, no screen.
- **Family umbrellas enumerate, never fetch.** The two hub-search rows
  are `[[enumerated]]` family seats (`[[enumerated]]`, never targets);
  the page family keeps its promote disposition — per-member registration
  is `D-P37.53-1`.
- **Drone bucketing waits on the schema.** Agency-by-month counts need
  the layers' published field names; declaring them blind fails closed —
  `D-P37.53-2`.
- **`payee:` stays unmapped** — P37.48's prefix was never registered in
  the subject-type map either; that typing decision is its family's,
  recorded here as a carried gap.
- **Fixture provenance.** Every `p37_53` fixture is a synthetic
  reconstruction of the served shape — never a fetched capture; the
  README + per-file comments say so.
